Glob patterns, * wildcard. Lines startin: Patrones glob, * como comodín. Las líneas que empiezan con # son comentarios. Vacío = filtro desactivado.
When enabled, log each excluded entity_i: Cuando está activado, cada entity_id excluido se registra individualmente durante la sincronización inicial del adaptador (requiere loglevel info o debug).
Cleanup excluded entities on adapter sta: Cleanup excluded entities on adapter start
When enabled, on each adapter start dele: When enabled, on each adapter start delete existing objects under entities.* whose entity_id matches the exclude patterns. Objects with custom adapter config (history/influxdb/sql) are kept and logged.
